simple.meaning: אֲכִילָה (ʼăkîylâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something eatable , i.e. food.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: אֲכִילָה (ʼăkîylâh) / H396 is traced through 1 Kings 19:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
